        "## Project Overview\n",
        "\n",
        "This project is developed as part of the Horizon TechX internship Task 4: Data Visualization Dashboard.\n",
        "\n",
        "The objective of this project is to transform raw sales data into meaningful charts and visual insights. The analysis focuses on product performance, sales trends, branches, customer types, and payment methods.\n",
        "\n",
        "Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn are used to analyze the dataset and create visualizations that support data-driven decision-making."
      ],

        "# Horizon TechX - Data Visualization Dashboard\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))\n",

        "axes[0, 0].set_title(\"Sales by Product Line\")\n",
        "axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis=\"x\", rotation=45)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Sales by Branch\n",
        "branch_sales = df.groupby(\"Branch\")[\"Total\"].sum()\n",
        "axes[0, 1].bar(branch_sales.index, branch_sales.values)\n",
        "axes[0, 1].set_title(\"Sales by Branch\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Sales by Customer Type\n",
        "customer_sales = df.groupby(\"Customer type\")[\"Total\"].sum()\n",
        "axes[1, 0].bar(customer_sales.index, customer_sales.values)\n",
        "axes[1, 0].set_title(\"Sales by Customer Type\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Sales by Payment Method\n",
        "payment_sales = df.groupby(\"Payment\")[\"Total\"].sum()\n",
        "axes[1, 1].bar(payment_sales.index, payment_sales.values)\n",
        "axes[1, 1].set_title(\"Sales by Payment Method\")\n",
        "\n",
        "fig.suptitle(\"Horizon TechX - Sales Data Visualization Dashboard\",\n",
        "             fontsize=18)\n",
